scenario.setting: Basement area with a sliding gate and stairs
scenario.robot_task: Transport an object from the main floor to the basement storage area.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot fails to properly secure the sliding gate after passing through, leaving it open.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human could accidentally access the basement and fall down the stairs, leading to injuries such as abrasions.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves through the sliding gate without ensuring it closes and latches securely.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: After passing through the gate, the robot stops, uses its sensors to detect if the gate is closed, and if not, performs a physical action to push or pull the gate until it is fully closed and latched.
scenario.assumptions: The robot is equipped with basic sensors to detect gate position and has the physical capability to manipulate the sliding gate.

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.main_floor = Object("main_floor", self.Location)
        self.basement_storage = Object("basement_storage", self.Location)
        self.gate_area = Object("gate_area", self.Location)
        self.delivery_item = Object("delivery_item", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.gate_open = Fluent("gate_open", BoolType())
        self.gate_latched = Fluent("gate_latched", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated

        self.setting_is_basement = Fluent("setting_is_basement", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_gate_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_gate_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_manipulate_gate = Fluent("robot_can_manipulate_gate", BoolType())
        self.stairs_present = Fluent("stairs_present", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.gate_open, self.gate_latched]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_basement, self.robot_has_gate_sensors, self.robot_can_manipulate_gate, self.stairs_present, self.humans_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.main_floor, self.basement_storage, self.gate_area, self.delivery_item]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_main_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_main_floor")
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.main_floor)))
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement_storage), False)
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gate_area), False)
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_basement_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_basement_storage")
        navigate_to_basement_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.basement_storage)))
        navigate_to_basement_storage.add_precondition(self.gate_open)  # Must pass through open gate
        navigate_to_basement_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), False)
        navigate_to_basement_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gate_area), False)
        navigate_to_basement_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_gate_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_gate_area")
        navigate_to_gate_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.gate_area)))
        navigate_to_gate_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), False)
        navigate_to_gate_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement_storage), False)
        navigate_to_gate_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.gate_area), True)

        # Open gate action - robot opens the sliding gate
        open_gate = InstantaneousAction("open_gate")
        open_gate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.gate_area))
        open_gate.add_precondition(Not(self.gate_open))
        open_gate.add_effect(self.gate_open, True)
        open_gate.add_effect(self.gate_latched, False)

        # Close gate action - robot closes the sliding gate
        close_gate = InstantaneousAction("close_gate")
        close_gate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.gate_area))
        close_gate.add_precondition(self.gate_open)
        close_gate.add_precondition(Not(self.gate_latched))
        close_gate.add_effect(self.gate_open, False)
        close_gate.add_effect(self.gate_latched, True)

        # Latch gate action - robot secures the gate latch
        latch_gate = InstantaneousAction("latch_gate")
        latch_gate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.gate_area))
        latch_gate.add_precondition(self.gate_open)
        latch_gate.add_precondition(Not(self.gate_latched))
        latch_gate.add_effect(self.gate_latched, True)

        # Grab item action - robot picks up delivery item
        grab_item = InstantaneousAction("grab_item")
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.main_floor))
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.main_floor))
        grab_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.main_floor), False)
        grab_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), True)

        # Place item action - robot puts delivery item at a location
        place_item = InstantaneousAction("place_item", at=self.Location)
        at = place_item.parameter("at")
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item))
        place_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, at), True)
        place_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), False)

        return navigate_to_main_floor, navigate_to_basement_storage, navigate_to_gate_area, open_gate, close_gate, latch_gate, grab_item, place_item

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_basement_storage": And([
                Not(self.gate_latched),  # Gate is not latched
                self.stairs_present,  # Stairs are present
                self.humans_present  # Humans are present
            ]),  # Moving through unlatched gate with humans present is dangerous

        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
